question: Which of the following describes reproduction involving only one parent and no gametes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Binary fission in Amoeba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Asexual reproduction** is a mode of reproduction where **offspring** are produced from a **single parent** without the involvement of **gamete** formation or **fertilization**.
 
• **Binary fission** in **Amoeba** is a classic example of **asexual reproduction** where the parent **unicellular organism** divides into two equal **daughter cells**. Since it involves only **one parent** and no **gametes**, it fits the description perfectly. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• **Fertilisation in frogs** is a type of **sexual reproduction** that involves the fusion of **male gametes (sperm)** and **female gametes (ova)**, typically occurring in **water** (external fertilization). ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
